metric.metric: Network latency, packet loss, and bandwidth
metric.definition: Continuous measurement of round-trip latency, loss rate, and utilization on the facility's internal fabric and external transit.

reading.body:
Network latency, packet loss, and bandwidth are tracked as continuous measurements of round-trip time, loss rate, and utilization across a facility's internal fabric and external transit connections.

Distributed AI training is described as unusually intolerant of network degradation, and a lossy fabric shows up as wasted GPU-hours before it shows up as a conventional outage, which is a different failure economics than most enterprise workloads face. A training job spread across many GPUs synchronizes constantly, so a small amount of packet loss that a normal application would barely notice can stall an entire cluster's compute while it waits on retransmitted data.

Its siblings under Uptime and redundancy are UPS battery health and generator runtime and SLA uptime compliance, which together track the different ways a facility's promised availability can actually fail in practice.

siblings.label: UPS battery health and generator runtime
